finalReading.passage: When Lucy first tried to write a poem, she felt sure that only clever experts could do it. Her teacher told her to start with one true feeling and a few simple words, so she wrote a short cinquain about her little brother. To her surprise, the class loved its gentle rhythm, and from that day she has written a new poem almost every week.

questions.q: What did Lucy believe before she tried writing a poem?
options: That only clever experts were able to write poetry.
That writing poems was very easy for everyone.
That poems should never have any feeling.
That she would win a famous prize.
questions.explanation: 原文 'she felt sure that only clever experts could do it' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What happened after Lucy read her cinquain to the class?
options: The class laughed at her and she stopped.
Her teacher asked her to leave.
The class loved it, and she has kept writing poems since.
She never wrote another poem again.
questions.explanation: 末句 'the class loved its gentle rhythm, and from that day she has written a new poem almost every week'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
